$description: AgentOS Design System Switch component spec — Control DNA toggle control with checked and loading preview states

layers.name: track
layers.role: switch track; background, border, radius, and horizontal padding

layers.name: content
layers.role: horizontal row for checked slot, unchecked slot, and thumb

layers.name: checkedSlot
layers.role: optional checked content preview; hidden by default in v1 scaffold

layers.name: uncheckedSlot
layers.role: optional unchecked content preview; hidden by default in v1 scaffold

layers.name: thumb
layers.role: circular handle that slides between checked and unchecked positions

state.antd: disabled + loading; hover is a design-time preview

trackPadding.reason: Switch track padding is a component geometry constant; no matching foundation token exists.

defaultTrackWidth.reason: Ant Design switch track min width is component-specific geometry.

defaultTrackHeight.reason: Switch track height does not map to existing controlHeight tokens.

smallTrackWidth.reason: Small switch track min width is component-specific geometry.

smallTrackHeight.reason: Small switch track height does not map to existing controlHeight tokens.

defaultThumbSize.reason: Switch handle size is a component token in Ant Design, not a current foundation token in AgentOS.

smallThumbSize.reason: Small switch handle size is a component token in Ant Design, not a current foundation token in AgentOS.

contentMinMargin.reason: Inner content margin is a switch-specific layout constant.

contentMinMarginSmall.reason: Small inner content margin is a switch-specific layout constant.

trackWidth.reason: Switch track geometry is fixed in v1.

trackHeight.reason: Switch track geometry is fixed in v1.

thumbSize.reason: Switch thumb geometry is fixed in v1.

trackWidth.reason: Switch track geometry is fixed in v1.

trackHeight.reason: Switch track geometry is fixed in v1.

thumbSize.reason: Switch thumb geometry is fixed in v1.

notes.scope: Base Switch only. This v1 scaffold focuses on size, checked state, disabled state, and loading preview.
notes.state: Hover, loading, and disabled are design preview states; runtime motion is intentionally not modeled in the component set.
notes.content: checkedChildren and unCheckedChildren are reserved as optional slot layers but not exposed as editable props in this first initialization.

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.

componentSets.*Switch*: Single set — Size=Default|Small × Value=Unchecked|Checked × State=Default|Hover|Loading|Disabled (16 variants)

figmaImplemented.note: Initialized in the AgentOS Design System file. The page contains only the *Switch* component set.

figmaConventions.variantLayout: State columns horizontally; Value groups inside each state; Size rows vertically.

gaps.name: trackGeometry
gaps.reason: Track width, height, and padding are switch-specific component constants with no approved Vision Token equivalents.

gaps.name: thumbGeometry
gaps.reason: Thumb size and slide offset are switch-specific geometry constants with no approved foundation tokens.

gaps.name: contentSlots
gaps.reason: checkedChildren and unCheckedChildren are reserved in the anatomy but not exposed in the initial Figma scaffold.

gaps.name: loadingSpinner
gaps.reason: The initial Figma scaffold uses opacity to preview loading; it does not yet model the runtime spinner treatment.
